description: Forward and regional defense logistics depot inventory records for F-35 LRUs (Line Replaceable Units) across UK and allied hubs. Used for stock availability checks, 30-day demand forecasts, and automated replenishment orders.

fields.name: nsn
fields.description: Primary Key (PK, Cluster Key): 13-digit NATO Stock Number uniquely identifying the standard logistics item (e.g., 1680-01-619-4821).

fields.name: part_name
fields.description: Formal military catalog item description (e.g., Port Electro-Hydrostatic Actuator (EHA) / Actuator, Electro-Hydrostatic Horizontal Tail).

fields.name: depot_id
fields.description: Cluster Key: Depot facility code (e.g., DEPOT-MAR-01 / DEP-UK-01 for RAF Marham Regional Sustainment Hub, DEPOT-QNLZ-02 / DEP-UK-02 for HMS Queen Elizabeth Mobile Spares Group).

fields.name: depot_name
fields.description: Full facility description of the warehouse or afloat forward logistics site (e.g., RAF Marham Regional Sustainment Hub, HMS Queen Elizabeth Mobile Spares Group).

fields.name: quantity_on_hand
fields.description: Unit: each (EA). Current serviceable (Condition Code A) parts physically held in storage bins available for immediate requisition.

fields.name: quantity_reserved_30d
fields.description: Unit: each (EA). Projected squadron demand and reserved allocations over the forward 30-day flying cycle.

fields.name: reorder_point_threshold
fields.description: Unit: each (EA). Minimum safety inventory level triggering automated logistics procurement alerts when on-hand stock falls to or below this threshold.

fields.name: avg_shipping_eta_hours
fields.description: Unit: hours (hrs). Mean transit and receipt inspection time in hours required to deliver the part to the squadron hangar (e.g., 18.0 hrs).
